+def _render_user(event: UserMessage) -> str:
+    return f"USER: {event.text}"
+
+
+def _render_assistant(event: AssistantMessage) -> str:
+    return f"ASSISTANT: {event.text}"
+
+
+def _render_tool_call(event: ToolCall) -> str:
+    return f"TOOL_CALL {event.tool}: {json.dumps(event.tool_input, sort_keys=True)}"
+
+
+def _render_tool_result(event: ToolResult) -> str:
+    suffix = " [error]" if event.is_error else ""
+    return f"TOOL_RESULT{suffix} ({event.tool}): {event.content}"
+
+
+def _render_shell(event: ShellCommand) -> str:
+    return f"SHELL $ {event.command} -> {event.output}"
+
+
+def _render_file_diff(event: FileDiff) -> str:
+    return f"FILE_DIFF {event.path}: {event.diff}"
+
+
+def _render_other(event: OtherEvent) -> str:
+    return f"OTHER: {event.description}"
+
+
+_RENDERERS: dict[type[Event], Callable[[Any], str]] = {
+    UserMessage: _render_user,
+    AssistantMessage: _render_assistant,
+    ToolCall: _render_tool_call,
+    ToolResult: _render_tool_result,
+    ShellCommand: _render_shell,
+    FileDiff: _render_file_diff,
+    OtherEvent: _render_other,
+}
+
+
+def _render_event(event: Event) -> str:
+    """Render one event as a numbered entry monitors can cite by index."""
